scope: Independent actual ESP-IDF allocation/API source trace for scan task startup failure and CPU-only BLE payload placement. No hardware, build, production edits, or proposed patch verification.

HILEvidenceReferenced.observed: READY ready0, stage scan_task_create_failed, err0x101; BOOT heap8295496. This reviewer did not query hardware.

confirmed.fact: 0x101 is ESP_ERR_NO_MEM in the actual installed SDK.
sensorarrayStartScanTask uses ordinary xTaskCreatePinnedToCore with CONFIG_SENSORARRAY_SCAN_TASK_STACK=16384. It returns NO_MEM if pdPASS/handle absent.

Xtensa StackType_t is uint8_t; stack depth is16384 bytes. configSTACK_ALLOCATION_FROM_SEPARATE_HEAP=0 aliases pvPortMallocStack to pvPortMalloc. pvPortMalloc requires MALLOC_CAP_INTERNAL|MALLOC_CAP_8BIT. A contiguous16KiB internal stack plus separate internalTCB allocation is required.
confirmed.source: FreeRTOSConfig.h:139; portable.h:191; Xtensa portmacro.h:88; heap_idf.c:43; freertos_tasks_c_additions.h:231

confirmed.fact: CONFIG_FREERTOS_TASK_CREATE_ALLOW_EXT_MEM=y permits explicitly provided external stack memory, but does not redirect ordinary task creation to PSRAM. WithCaps would explicitly use heap_caps_malloc for stack whileTCB stays internal; changing the acquisition stack is not recommended by this review.

The existing BOOT heap field uses esp_get_free_heap_size, not an INTERNAL|8BIT largest-block observation; it cannot prove scan task allocation capacity. Existing APP_BOOT_MEM reports internalFree/internalLargest/internalMin and should be captured at before-scan/after allocation.

The current static s_ble contains DATA4+LOG2+protected2 data payloads of2304 bytes each:18432 payload bytes before metadata. Build02 map places s_ble in .data (0x5a28 bytes). RTOS queue structures, metadata, guard and scratch share the object. A whole-object move is unnecessary and would broaden cache/RTOS constraints.

esp_ble_gatts_send_indicate passes the value to btc_transfer_context. That function synchronously executes btc_gatts_arg_deep_copy before posting the BTC message; the GATTS callback allocates its own value buffer and memcpy. The application payload is CPU-readable source, not a direct peripheral DMA descriptor/buffer owned by GATT hardware. Fragmented data is also copied to txPacketScratch before the call.

minimalCandidateConstraints: Allocate a boot-lifetime CPU-only payload slab once with MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM|MALLOC_CAP_8BIT, before any caller/task can publish or consume it; keep internal slot metadata and only point payload accesses at the slab.

Keep muxes, guard/timing state, RTOS queue/semaphore control and storage, TCBs, scan/driver-critical stacks, and actual DMA descriptors/internal scratch unchanged. Do not use DMA flags for this text slab or claim PSRAM eliminates DMA lifetime constraints.

Never place allocation/free/copy under a critical section; preserve reserveWRITING, copyoutside, commitPENDING and OWNED until actual SDK return. A timeout/quarantine is not evidence of return and must not permit freeing/reusing payload.

Cover storage allocation with the existing one-time init claim/result; avoid later memset erasing installed pointers, repeated init replacing storage, or callbacks seeing successful init before allocation. Allocation failure must be explicit and leave no usable partial payload state; avoid silently falling back to enough internal memory to starve acquisition again.
CONFIG_SPIRAM_ALLOW_BSS_SEG_EXTERNAL_MEMORY is disabled, so adding an externalBSS attribute alone is not an established fix. PSRAM/XIP/cache settings remain unchanged.

External RAM requires cache availability. The inspected BLE data copying/CRC/send paths are ordinary task context and no IRAM/ISR payload access was found. Keep fault observer metadata internal; do not generalize this finding to ADS DMA or arbitrary system objects.

SDK deep copy still allocates its own buffers and BTC posting can block; freeing application internal payload space does not prove all SDK allocations/sends succeed or peer receipt. Preserve the existing timeout observer and local accepted-vs-delivered contract.
validationNeededByImplementationOwner: Actual before/after ELF/map internal static size and all pointer/lifetime host tests including allocation failure/reentrant init.
Capture internal8bit free/largest around startup, successful scan creation plus FDC/ADS workers, BLE/USB initialization, real protected-frame traffic and stack watermarks.
No capacity/queue reduction, stack shrinking, FPS cap or hardware reset workaround should be called the memory fix.
causeBoundary: Task creation failed with actualNO_MEM and current ordinary API requires internal stack/TCB. Without internal largest-block telemetry at the failing instant this reviewer does not distinguish total internal exhaustion from fragmentation or TCB failure solely from aggregate8MB heap.
